title: Ano Ba Talaga ang Solar?
audience: First-time homeowners curious about rooftop solar
premise: Sunlight becomes DC electricity in the panels; the inverter turns it into the AC the home uses; when solar is short, the grid or a battery supplies the rest.
scriptBasis: Claude draft from the 104-episode backlog title/angle, V1.1 brand lines; claims checked online 2026-11-24.

sources: Sources: U.S. DOE & EIA solar basics; Meralco Solar & Net Metering

cues.text: Ano ba talaga ang ginagawa ng solar panels mo?
Simple lang: liwanag ng araw ang tumatama sa panels.
Ginagawa itong DC na kuryente ng solar cells.
cues.say: Ginagawa itong D-C na kuryente ng solar cells.

cues.text: Pero AC ang gamit ng appliances sa bahay.
cues.say: Pero A-C ang gamit ng appliances sa bahay.

cues.text: Kaya may inverter: ginagawa nitong AC ang DC.
cues.say: Kaya may inverter: ginagawa nitong A-C ang D-C.

cues.text: Habang may araw, solar ang tumutulong sa bahay mo.
Kapag kulang o gabi na, grid o battery ang sasalo.
Panels, inverter, at tamang setup. 'Yan ang solar!
Dahil ang gusto ni Kuya SoLight… naka-solar ka na, SoSmart ka pa!

claims.wording: Solar panels convert sunlight into DC electricity.

claims.wording: Home appliances use AC; the inverter converts the panels' DC into AC.
claims.caveats: Some DC appliances exist; typical homes use AC.

claims.wording: When solar is not enough or at night, a grid-connected home uses the grid or a battery.

claims.caveats: Battery supply depends on capacity and configuration.

sources.title: Solar Integration: Inverters and Grid Services Basics
excerpts: Inverters change the variable direct current (DC) output of PV into alternating current (AC) for the grid and household use.

sources.title: Photovoltaics and electricity
excerpts: PV cells convert sunlight directly into electricity (DC); output depends on available sunlight.

The Meralco grid supplies the property when renewable generation is not enough.
Exported energy is credited under net metering.

caption.main:
Ano ba talaga ang solar? Liwanag → panels (DC) → inverter (AC) → bahay mo. Kapag kulang o gabi na, grid o battery ang sasalo. ☀️

SoSmart viewers, may tanong kayo sa solar? I-comment lang! 👇
